caption:
There are only four ways to lose, and you run one of them.

Not four mistakes — four patterns, each with its own logic, its own timing and its own excuse. The frozen, who know exactly what to do and don't. The runaway, who acts first and reads afterwards. The watched, whose execution is decided by an audience. The attacker, whose strength is what hides the drift.

You've been treating yours as a personal flaw. It has a name.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll send you the free trader profile test.
